$comment: CANONICAL ROLE LIST — single source of truth for both apps (miv frontend + miv-backend Payload). Any role name used in code MUST match a `value` in this file. Draft pending review with June + PO (see RBAC_MATRIX.md).

roles.label: Founder
roles.description: Venture founder. Sees/edits only their own venture's data. First role to release.
roles.blocker: MIGRATION REQUIRED — the Prisma UserRole enum has no `founder` value (miv/prisma/schema.prisma). Because founder is release #1, this is a scheduled schema migration + data migration, NOT adoption wiring. Cannot ship founder in the frontend until the enum carries it.

roles.label: Admin
roles.description: Full system access, including destructive operations and system settings. Second release.

roles.label: MIV Analyst
roles.description: MIV staff. Read/write across ventures, documents, and media; no destructive system operations. Third release.

roles.label: Mentor
roles.description: DO NOT BUILD. No dashboards, no access rules, no UI until a permissions matrix for this role is formally documented and approved.

roles.label: Investor
roles.description: DO NOT BUILD. No dashboards, no access rules, no UI until a permissions matrix for this role is formally documented and approved.

unresolvedLegacyRoles.$comment: Roles that exist in code today but have no canonical mapping. DECISION REQUIRED at June/PO review. These are NOT decorative — migrating or deleting them is a BEHAVIOUR CHANGE, not a cleanup. See load-bearing usages below.

loadBearingUsages.user_cannot_be_deleted: miv/app/auth/login/page.tsx branches on `role === 'user'` to pick the landing page. #57 fixed the target (user + founder both go to /user-dashboard) but the branch still reads the value, so deleting `user` breaks login routing.
loadBearingUsages.enum_drives_email_content: VENTURE_MANAGER / GEDSI_ANALYST / CAPITAL_FACILITATOR gate email body content across ~10 conditionals in miv/app/api/(operations)/emails/stg-reminder and weekly-update.
loadBearingUsages.enum_drives_team_management: miv/app/api/(operations)/team/members/route.ts hardcodes all 8 enum values in a Zod enum and writes the selected role; miv/app/dashboard/(operations)/team-management/page.tsx is the assignment UI. Renaming to snake_case changes behaviour in these routes.

adoption.$warning: Collection access blocks do NOT enforce app behaviour. All miv-backend routes reach Payload via the Local API, which defaults overrideAccess:true (overrideAccess appears nowhere in miv-backend/src). Declared collection/global access governs only the admin panel and the generated REST API. Role enforcement for app traffic must be added in the route handlers.
adoption.$note_json_import: resolveJsonModule is already true in both tsconfigs, so importing this file compiles in both apps.
orderedSequence: 1. DATA MIGRATION FIRST — remap existing user records off legacy values (Prisma seeds still mint MANAGER and VENTURE_MANAGER; Payload records still hold `user`). Do this before anything reads the new list, or in-flight users are orphaned.
2. Settle the login redirect rule (see redirectRule) as part of the `user` mapping decision — #57 routes both `user` and `founder` to /user-dashboard, so the mapping changes routing for real users.

3. CODEGEN SECOND — only after (1): generate the backend `role` select from status==='active' roles, and migrate the Prisma UserRole enum to snake_case. Dropping `user`/legacy values before the data moves will break login routing, seeds, and the team-management + email routes that read them.
4. Re-introduce a frontend route-protection gate — #57 deleted miv/middleware.ts; there is now NO middleware in miv, so nothing checks cookie/role before a dashboard renders.
5. Add route-handler role enforcement — the Local API bypass (see $warning) means the collection matrix does not protect app traffic.
adoption.backend_helpers: Access helpers already exist in miv-backend/src/access/roles.ts (adminOrAnalyst, selfOrAdminAccess, founderOfVenture) but are imported by NOTHING, and founderOfVenture is currently broken (see RBAC_MATRIX §6 / anomaly A4). Do not assume wiring them in is sufficient.
adoption.redirectRule: TBD at review — the `user` mapping decision determines where mapped users land (#57: user + founder → /user-dashboard, staff → /dashboard). Settle the redirect rule and the mapping together.
adoption.ci: HOLD — do NOT add a role-lint CI check yet. .github/workflows currently holds only sync-upstream.yml (cron); the actual pipeline is #56 (Akshit) and is red. There is nothing to attach the check to. Revisit once #56 is green.
